state.objective: Find why billing reconciliation showed 1-cent discrepancy on monthly invoices.

context.content: Monthly audit report: 1,420 invoices had mismatch of -$0.01 between line items sum and invoice total.
Invoices generated on the 1st of every month via Celery cron.

submitted_answer.answer: The 1-cent discrepancy is consistent with binary floating-point rounding in currency arithmetic.
